book.lesson_titles_note: A book of its own, ingested from its PDF by the book-record pipeline (Tamer, 2026-10-17: treated as a separate book, unrelated to any live course). Its course, course:prep3-parallel-math-en (app/src/lib/courses.ts), is hidden until an operator makes it live. Its lesson slugs carry the pp3 prefixes (pp3u1-1, …), so none of its ids can meet another course's. Lesson titles, page offsets and units come from its own S0 lesson map, approved at G0.

widgets.stem: For the function $n(x)=\frac{x-1}{x^2-9}$, mark every value of $x$ that must be excluded from the domain.
widgets.instrument: Spec example {"mode":"points","range":[-6,6],"targets":[-2,3]} — the student taps values on a number line; the answer is a SET and is graded as one (1–4 targets). The other mode is {"mode":"interval","range":[-6,6],"from":2,"to":6,"openFrom":true,"openTo":true} — an inequality, where the student also sets each endpoint hollow (excluded, < or >) or filled (included, ≤ or ≥). Validator limits (parseMathWidget): "range" is two increasing whole numbers within ±20, at most 24 wide; every target, and each interval endpoint (from ≤ to), is a whole number inside the range.

reading_fields.openFrom: true if the left end is excluded
reading_fields.openTo: true if the right end is excluded

diagnostics.predicate_meaning: Marked values that the answer set does not contain
diagnostics.misconception_label: Removes the zeroes of the numerator instead of the denominator
diagnostics.misconception_description: The student sets the top of the fraction equal to zero and takes the domain as R minus those values.

diagnostics.predicate_meaning: Part of the answer set was not marked
diagnostics.misconception_label: Finds only the positive root of the denominator
diagnostics.misconception_description: When the denominator has the form $x^2=k$, the student gives only $x=\sqrt{k}$ and loses the negative root.
